description: Boundary and rendering edge cases for the progress-update display fields. Covers the zero boundaries (expectedFileSize=0, networkSpeed=0, timeRemaining=0 are all 'available' yet the speed/time strings show placeholders), the kB/s vs MB/s switch at exactly 1, sub-1 rounding down to 0 kB/s, the MM:SS vs H:MM:SS switch at exactly 3600 seconds, and multi-hour formatting.
